successCriteria.description: UpdateLeaveRequestDto in src/shared/types/index.ts exposes optional approverId (string | null) and decidedAt (Date | null) fields alongside the existing startDate/endDate/reason/status.
FIELD_COLUMNS in src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts maps approverId -> approver_id and decidedAt -> decided_at so the repository.update dynamic SET clause can persist both columns.

approve() in src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts sets approverId = actor.id and decidedAt = now (a Date) in the same repository.update call that flips status to APPROVED, inside the existing uow.withTransaction.

reject() in src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts sets approverId = actor.id and decidedAt = now (a Date) in the same repository.update call that flips status to REJECTED, inside the existing uow.withTransaction.
The persisted row returned by approve/reject has non-null approverId equal to the deciding actor's id and a non-null decidedAt timestamp; the audit afterState reflects these values (no longer null).
Existing Jest tests for the leave service still pass and new/updated tests assert approverId/decidedAt are populated on approve and reject (and remain null on create/submit).

constraints: The approverId/decidedAt write must happen inside the existing uow.withTransaction block in approve/reject — it is part of the atomic status-change + balance-update + audit + notification unit of work, not a separate write.
The repository.update call must forward the transaction's PoolClient as the optional last argument (per AGENTS.md transaction-boundary rule); no new pool/client import in the service.
approverId/decidedAt must be added to the existing UpdateLeaveRequestDto and FIELD_COLUMNS — do not introduce a new DTO type or a separate repository method for the decision write.
The LeaveRequest model's 12-field canonical shape is unchanged — this phase only populates existing approverId/decidedAt fields; no field is added, renamed, or removed from the model.
decidedAt must be a real Date (the decision timestamp), not a string; it must round-trip through the repository's mapRow as a Date.
outOfScope: Populating approvalComment or submittedAt — this phase only adds approverId and decidedAt; approvalComment/submittedAt remain out of scope.
Adding a cancel operation, a GET/list route, or any new endpoint — the phase is confined to the existing approve/reject update path.
Changing authorization rules, balance-counter math, audit/notification side effects, or the transaction boundary itself — those are already correct and untouched.

ambiguities.description: Whether decidedAt should be captured as the exact decision moment (new Date() at the point of the update) or derived from a single timestamp shared with the audit occurredAt.
options: Use new Date() at the point of the repository.update call
Reuse the audit entry's occurredAt timestamp for consistency

ambiguities.description: Whether approverId/decidedAt should be optional (string | null / Date | null) or required in UpdateLeaveRequestDto.
options: Optional (consistent with the existing all-optional DTO shape)
Required (only ever set together on decision)

entityInvariants.invariant: A LeaveRequest in APPROVED or REJECTED state must have a non-null approverId (the deciding actor's id) and a non-null decidedAt timestamp; a DRAFT or SUBMITTED request keeps both null.
approverId must equal the authenticated deciding actor's id (never the requester, per the no-self-approval rule already enforced by assertCanDecide).

interfaceConstraints.authRule: MANAGER or ADMIN only; no self-approval; a MANAGER must be the requester's direct manager (unchanged — this phase does not alter authorization).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: ConflictError on non-SUBMITTED status; ForbiddenError on unauthorized actor; NotFoundError on unknown request/balance — unchanged from current behavior.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: MANAGER or ADMIN only; no self-rejection; a MANAGER must be the requester's direct manager (unchanged).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: ConflictError on non-SUBMITTED status; ForbiddenError on unauthorized actor; NotFoundError on unknown request/balance — unchanged.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: UpdateLeaveRequestDto must extend the existing DTO in src/shared/types/index.ts (add approverId/decidedAt) rather than define a parallel type; the repository's UpdateField/FIELD_COLUMNS typing must remain keyed off UpdateLeaveRequestDto.

FIELD_COLUMNS additions must map to the exact snake_case columns approver_id and decided_at already present in the COLUMNS constant and LeaveRequestRow/mapRow in leave.repository.ts, so update() and mapRow stay in sync.

The approve/reject transaction must continue to satisfy the reconciled transaction_contract: status change + approver_id/decided_at + balance counters + audit insert + notification insert all inside one IUnitOfWork.withTransaction, with the client forwarded to each participating call.
The LeaveRequest model's approverId/decidedAt nullability (string | null / Date | null) must remain unchanged; this phase only populates them, matching the canonical 12-field shape in leave.model.ts.

integrationPoints.why: The dynamic SET clause must be able to persist approver_id/decided_at; the service's update call depends on this mapping.
The DTO is the shared contract the service passes to repository.update; it must carry approverId/decidedAt for the decision write.

integrationPoints.target: src/modules/audit (AuditService.record) — afterState of the APPROVE/REJECT audit entry
integrationPoints.why: The audit afterState must now reflect the populated approverId/decidedAt, closing the divergence noted in ARCHITECTURE.md.
